questions.question: How many distinct real roots does the equation $x^4 - 61x^2 + 330 = 0$ possess?
questions.solution: Factoring $(x^2 - 55)(x^2 - 6) = 0$ with $55 \neq 6 > 0$ yields $4$ distinct real roots $\pm\sqrt{55}, \pm\sqrt{6}$.
questions.explanation: Apply discriminant & nature of roots techniques in Coordinate Geometry (Straight Lines & Circles) (Orthogonal Circles Condition).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $x^2 - 57x + 56 = 0$ and $x^2 - 8x + k = 0$ share the common root $x = 1$, find the value of $k$.
questions.solution: Substituting the common root $x = 1$ into the second equation gives $1 - (8) + k = 0 \implies k = 7$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Coordinate Geometry (Straight Lines & Circles) (Family of Circles & Radical Axis).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $2x^2 + 114x + 16 = 0$ and $x^2 + p x + q = 0$ have both roots in common, find the value of $p + q$.
questions.solution: Proportionality of coefficients $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{p}{114} = \frac{q}{16} \implies p = 57,\; q = 8 \implies p + q = 65$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Coordinate Geometry (Straight Lines & Circles) (Image of Point & Orthocenter).

questions.category: Location of Roots on Real Axis
questions.question: Find the largest integral value of $m$ for which the number $x = 2$ lies strictly between the two real roots of $f(x) = x^2 - 4x + m = 0$.
questions.solution: For $x = 2$ to lie strictly between the roots, $f(2) < 0 \implies 2^2 - 2(2^2) + m < 0 \implies m < 4$, so largest integer is $3$.
questions.explanation: Apply location of roots on real axis techniques in Coordinate Geometry (Straight Lines & Circles) (Director Circle & Chord of Contact).
